method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

revisions.source: The most fervent anti-war wing of the party cheers you on.
revisions.zh: 党内最坚定的反战派为你喝彩。

revisions.source: This position is lifted straight from the Republican platform.
revisions.zh: 这个立场直接照搬了共和党党纲。

revisions.source: This is a broadly popular stance.
revisions.zh: 这是一个广受欢迎的立场。

revisions.source: This is a broadly popular stance, but it definitely alienates a key bloc of Democrats.
revisions.zh: 这是一个广受欢迎的立场，但也确实疏远了民主党一个重要的支持群体。

revisions.source: Good luck in this year's election. Many people think it will awfully close.
revisions.zh: 祝你今年选举顺利。许多人认为双方会争得极为胶着。

revisions.source: Immediate independence of the Philippines is not the popular position for Republicans.
revisions.zh: 立即让菲律宾独立，在共和党人中并不受欢迎。

revisions.source: Conservatives have denounced the 17th Amendment, but it is broadly popular.
revisions.zh: 保守派谴责第十七修正案，但它广受欢迎。

revisions.source: The League of Nations idea is viewed with suspicion by many conservatives, and anti-war progressives alike.
revisions.zh: 许多保守派和反战的进步派，都对建立国际联盟的构想抱有疑虑。

revisions.source: There's nothing wrong with postponing judgment on this issue.
revisions.zh: 暂缓对这个问题作出判断，没有什么不妥。

revisions.source: You are certainly running an aggressive campaign on the military issues.
revisions.zh: 你在军事议题上的竞选攻势确实很强。

revisions.source: This position is too anti-war for many in your party to accept.
revisions.zh: 这个立场过于反战，让党内许多人无法接受。

revisions.source: This is a break from the party platform, but it might help in the Western states.
revisions.zh: 这偏离了党纲，但可能有助于争取西部各州。

revisions.source: This in line with the feelings of your Party.
revisions.zh: 这符合你所在政党的倾向。

revisions.source: You are definitely sticking to conservative points in this campaign.
revisions.zh: 在这场竞选中，你确实一直坚持保守派的主张。

revisions.source: Many in your party are in favor of Prohibition, but there is a significant minority on the other side. Particularly among the German wing.
revisions.zh: 党内许多人赞成禁酒，但也有相当一部分人持反对意见，尤其是德裔群体。

revisions.source: This is a controversial stance, and it is probably aligned with the minority within your party.
revisions.zh: 这是一个有争议的立场，站在你党内少数派一边的可能性很大。

revisions.source: People are surprised to hear you in sympathy with the progressive wing of the Democratic coalition.
revisions.zh: 听到你赞同民主党联盟中的进步派，人们感到惊讶。

revisions.source: This is a safe position for a Republican to take.
revisions.zh: 对共和党人来说，这是个稳妥的立场。

revisions.source: There is still conservative opposition to the Federal Reserve, but even that wing of the party is divided on the issue.
revisions.zh: 保守派仍有人反对联邦储备制度，但就连党内这一派在此事上也存在分歧。

revisions.source: This is a very advanced position for a Republican to take on federal regulation.
revisions.zh: 对共和党人来说，在联邦监管问题上采取这个立场，已是相当进步了。

revisions.source: You continue to make conservative points on the campaign trail.
revisions.zh: 你继续在竞选中强调保守派的主张。

revisions.source: Somewhat counter to initial expectations, you continue to press the conservative case as you campaign.
revisions.zh: 与最初的预期有些不同，你继续在竞选中力陈保守派的主张。

revisions.source: This is a controversial step, which has certainly created much bewilderment from your party.
revisions.zh: 这是有争议的一步，确实让党内许多人十分困惑。

revisions.source: There are some attacks about this meeting, but it could also help keep German-Americans in the fold.
revisions.zh: 有人抨击这次会见，但它也可能有助于留住德裔美国人的支持。

revisions.source: Red-blooded Americans cheer your strong stance on this position.
revisions.zh: 自诩铁血爱国的美国人为你的强硬立场喝彩。

revisions.source: Significant concern is beginning to develop among Republicans over the level of immigration that has been permitted.
revisions.zh: 共和党人开始对获准入境的移民数量产生严重担忧。

revisions.source: Congress has just such a bill in the works right now.
revisions.zh: 国会眼下正在酝酿的，正是这样一项法案。

revisions.source: This is a surprisingly anti-war position for you, given initial expectations.
revisions.zh: 考虑到最初的预期，你这个反战立场令人意外。

revisions.source: Jingoists and so on favor this stance, but there is a significant German bloc of Republicans who you should still be worried about.
revisions.zh: 沙文主义者等人支持这个立场，但共和党内还有相当一批德裔选民，你仍需顾及他们。

revisions.source: What motivated you to place Newton Baker on the ticket for your attempt at reelection?
revisions.zh: 在争取连任时，你为什么选择牛顿·贝克作为竞选搭档？

revisions.source: Will you make any statements about the increased regulation of narcotics and stimulants such as a cocaine, which began with the 1914 Harrison Act?
revisions.zh: 1914年的《哈里森法》开始加强对麻醉药品，以及可卡因等兴奋剂的监管。你会就此发表意见吗？

revisions.source: Newton Baker is the best man for the job. Regardless of any political gossip, the President needs a reliable working partner as Vice President.
revisions.zh: 牛顿·贝克是担任这个职位的最佳人选。不管政界有什么闲言碎语，总统都需要一位可靠的副总统作为工作搭档。

revisions.source: Newton Baker is the progressive choice for Vice President, and I have every confidence in his abilities.
revisions.zh: 牛顿·贝克是副总统人选中的进步派选择，我对他的能力完全有信心。

revisions.source: This is yet another positive example of progressive legislation that has been enacted over the previous few years.
revisions.zh: 这又是过去几年通过的进步主义立法的一个正面例子。

revisions.source: This isn't an important issue in our current campaign.
revisions.zh: 这不是我们当前竞选中的重要议题。

revisions.source: What themes will you emphasize as you accept the Republican nomination and begin your campaign?
revisions.zh: 在接受共和党提名、展开竞选时，你会强调哪些主题？

revisions.source: In making appointments to your campaign (and by implication, when you are President), will you favor traditional Republicans, Progressives, or try for an even balance?
revisions.zh: 在任命竞选团队成员时——也意味着日后担任总统时——你会偏向传统共和党人、进步派，还是尽量均衡安排？

revisions.source: What position will you take in regards to the war in Europe as you campaign?
revisions.zh: 在竞选中，你会对欧洲战争采取什么立场？

revisions.source: Theodore Roosevelt is hitting the campaign trail hard this fall. However, he continues to make bellicose speeches about the war in Europe. Will you distance yourself from his rhetoric?
revisions.zh: 西奥多·罗斯福今年秋季正积极投入竞选活动，但仍不断就欧洲战争发表好战言论。你会与他的说法划清界限吗？

revisions.source: What do you make of Woodrow Wilson's response to the raids and outrages of Pancho Villa?
revisions.zh: 对于伍德罗·威尔逊应对潘乔·比利亚袭击和暴行的做法，你怎么看？

revisions.source: Do you have any plans to attack the nomination of Louis Brandeis to the Supreme Court?
revisions.zh: 你打算抨击路易斯·布兰代斯获提名出任最高法院大法官一事吗？

revisions.source: How much will you emphasize your own reform efforts as Governor of New York, as you campaign nationally?
revisions.zh: 在全国竞选时，你会在多大程度上强调自己担任纽约州州长期间的改革政绩？

revisions.source: Do you plan to attack Woodrow Wilson's stance on preparedness and war with Europe, and if so, how?
revisions.zh: 你打算抨击伍德罗·威尔逊在备战和对欧战争问题上的立场吗？如果打算，会如何抨击？

revisions.source: California, an important state this fall, is in the midst of a divisive split between Progressives and traditional Republicans. What are your own plans for visiting that state?
revisions.zh: 加利福尼亚州是今年秋季的重要战场，进步派与传统共和党人之间的尖锐分裂正在撕裂该州党内。你打算怎样安排赴该州的行程？

revisions.source: What are your opinions on child labor legislation, as exemplified by the recent Keating-Owens child labor bill?
revisions.zh: 最近提出的基廷—欧文童工法案，是童工立法的一例。你对这类立法有什么看法？

revisions.source: Do you have any statements to make on the tariff question, and/or the recently established Tariff Commission, as you campaign?
revisions.zh: 竞选期间，你会就关税问题，以及最近成立的关税委员会发表什么意见吗？

revisions.source: Woodrow Wilson has recently pushed through the Adamson Act to avert a railroad strike, which establishes an eight-hour day for railroad employees. Will you attack this action in your campaign?
revisions.zh: 伍德罗·威尔逊最近推动通过《亚当森法》，以避免铁路罢工，为铁路雇员确立了八小时工作制。你会在竞选中抨击这一举措吗？

revisions.source: What do you make of the Preparedness Day Parades which have sprung up across the country this summer?
revisions.zh: 今年夏季，全国各地兴起了“备战日”游行。你对此怎么看？

revisions.source: My record as Governor of New York shows that I am willing to enact progressive reforms, and to combat machine politics. I will bring this mentality to the national stage as President.
revisions.zh: 我担任纽约州州长的政绩表明，我愿意推行进步主义改革，打击政治机器。作为总统，我会把这种作风带到全国。

revisions.source: Mr. Wilson has veered between ineptness on the one hand, and sudden, radical solutions on the other. I am the safe, pragmatic alternative in this contest.
revisions.zh: 威尔逊先生一会儿无能失措，一会儿又突然推出激进的解决办法。在这场竞选中，我是稳妥、务实的选择。

revisions.source: We can all agree on the need for reform, in this day in age. The question is, will we have sensible, moderate change or naked overreach?
revisions.zh: 在这个时代，我们都能认同改革的必要性。问题在于，我们要的是明智、温和的改变，还是公然越权？

revisions.source: We've seen alarming measures during Wilson's first term. I stand firmly opposed to the income tax, the new interference with business, and the reduction in tariffs which will undermine our prosperity.
revisions.zh: 威尔逊第一任期推出的一些措施令人担忧。我坚决反对所得税、对企业的新干预，以及将损害我国繁荣的降低关税政策。

revisions.source: Mr. Wilson's vacillations on the issue have emboldened potential adversaries and led to unfortunate events like the sinking of the Lusitania. A more resolute policy would actually increase the chances for peace.
revisions.zh: 威尔逊先生在这个问题上摇摆不定，助长了潜在敌手的气焰，导致了卢西塔尼亚号被击沉这样的悲剧。采取更坚定的政策，实际上会增加实现和平的机会。

revisions.source: As President, I have no desire for war. However, I will spare no effort to protect the legitimate rights of American shipping and commerce.
revisions.zh: 作为总统，我并不希望战争。不过，为了保护美国航运和贸易的正当权利，我将不遗余力。

revisions.source: If Mr. Wilson continues to allow American ships to travel in dangerous areas, it is only a matter of time before we are drawn into war. His claims to be the peace candidate ring hollow.
revisions.zh: 如果威尔逊先生继续允许美国船只驶入危险海域，我们被拖入战争只是时间问题。他自称是和平候选人，听起来空洞无物。

revisions.source: Wilson has repeatedly taken half-measures, when we should be doing much more to prepare for the threat of war.
revisions.zh: 面对战争威胁，我们本该做更多准备，威尔逊却一再采取半吊子的措施。

revisions.source: I refuse to politicize the security of the United States. Wilson and I are both in support of the current measures.
revisions.zh: 我拒绝把美国的安全问题政治化。威尔逊和我都支持当前的措施。

revisions.source: Preparedness is a bellicose policy which leads us closer to the very thing we are preparing against -- war, that is.
revisions.zh: 备战是一项好战政策，会让我们更接近本来要防范的事——也就是战争。

revisions.source: If we must make a decision, we should appeal to the progressive element of the party. These voters are the most likely ones to bolt for Wilson this fall.
revisions.zh: 如果必须作出取舍，我们就应当争取党内进步派。这些选民最有可能在今年秋季转投威尔逊。

revisions.source: I'm a moderate candidate, and my purpose is to tie the different strands of our party into a unified whole. My appointments will reflect this.
revisions.zh: 我是一位温和的候选人，目的是把党内不同力量团结成一个整体。我的人事任命也会体现这一点。

revisions.source: The great mass of voters in this country are Republicans. If we keep the mainstream elements of the party happy, they will deliver us a victory in November.
revisions.zh: 本国广大选民都是共和党人。只要让党内主流满意，他们就会在十一月为我们带来胜利。

revisions.source: I believe the appointment of Louis Brandeis to the Court shows exceptionally poor, and dangerous, judgment on the part of Woodrow Wilson.
revisions.zh: 我认为，伍德罗·威尔逊任命路易斯·布兰代斯进入最高法院，显示出他极其糟糕、而且危险的判断力。

revisions.source: We would be better served to focus on other issues as we campaign.
revisions.zh: 竞选中，我们最好把重点放在其他议题上。

revisions.source: I have a substantial record of reform and progressivism as Governor of New York, and as a Supreme Court Justice. I won't hesitate to say so as I campaign.
revisions.zh: 无论作为纽约州州长，还是最高法院大法官，我都有丰富的改革和进步主义政绩。我在竞选中会毫不犹豫地指出这一点。

revisions.source: My history as Governor of New York shows that I can balance the need for reform with respect for established institutions.
revisions.zh: 我担任纽约州州长的经历表明，我能够在改革需要与尊重现有制度之间取得平衡。

revisions.source: Obviously it is helpful to remind the voters of my achievements, but our primary focus should be on Woodrow Wilson and the issues of 1916.
revisions.zh: 显然，提醒选民我的政绩很有帮助，但我们应当主要关注伍德罗·威尔逊和1916年的议题。

revisions.source: We will plan our own visit to that state, and call upon the Governor and his opponents equally, to avoid giving offense.
revisions.zh: 我们将自行安排赴该州的行程，对州长和他的对手一视同仁地拜访，以免得罪任何一方。

revisions.source: It's best not to wade into the middle of a controversy -- we should not make any large trip to California during this campaign.
revisions.zh: 最好别卷入争端——这次竞选中，我们不应大张旗鼓地前往加利福尼亚州。

revisions.source: The Governor of California can barely be called a Republican. We will coordinate our itinerary with the established party apparatus on our visit.
revisions.zh: 加利福尼亚州州长简直算不上共和党人。访问期间，我们会与现有的党组织协调行程。

revisions.source: I would actually redouble the points that Roosevelt is making about our lack of military preparation.
revisions.zh: 实际上，我会进一步强化罗斯福对我国军事准备不足的批评。

revisions.source: I'm not going to comment on the speeches of Teddy Roosevelt -- there is too much to lose in antagonizing him.
revisions.zh: 我不会评论泰迪·罗斯福的演说——得罪他的代价太大了。

revisions.source: I will emphasize that I am my own man, and that I believe the one-sided neutrality of Woodrow Wilson is at risk of pushing us into a war with Germany.
revisions.zh: 我会强调自己有独立的主张，并认为伍德罗·威尔逊片面的中立政策，有把我们推入对德战争的危险。

revisions.source: Wilson's impetuous actions in pushing this into law, with no chance for debate in Congress, are incorrect and dangerous.
revisions.zh: 威尔逊不让国会有机会辩论，就急着推动这项法律通过，这种做法是错误而危险的。

revisions.source: We all have different opinions about the Adamson Act, and I don't propose to make it a big part of my campaign speech.
revisions.zh: 我们对《亚当森法》各有看法，我不打算让它成为竞选演说的重要内容。

revisions.source: Wilson and I may have our differences on other issues, but I believe an eight-hour workday is broadly popular and worthy of praise.
revisions.zh: 威尔逊和我在其他问题上也许有分歧，但我认为八小时工作制广受欢迎，值得赞扬。
